intro_summary: 本章以盒子球數、加法前提和授權欄位分別檢查誠實、修正與拒絕；把內容的可見依據、行為邊界和能推進任務的幫助分開，再換問法檢查規則，最後用三候選分數和四題信心理解自信與答對率的差別。

No old technical/readability reports or author notes read. No source or figure edits.

claims.statement: 有用、誠實、安全是本章分開檢視的行為要求；缺可見球數時，說明缺項並請補資料比無依據填3更符合有用與誠實。
claims.scope: Task-level teaching criteria and human-labelled example. Safety here is the task-defined boundary; no claim of universal alignment or model competence.

evidence.locator: §1.1 “What are Helpfulness, Honesty, and Harmlessness?”, PDF pp.4–5; text lines 165–236
evidence.supports: HHH criteria may conflict; helpfulness includes obtaining necessary details; honesty requires appropriate uncertainty/knowledge limits; harms depend on context.

evidence.locator: Human-Preference on Harmlessness and Helpfulness: Helpfulness of a Response
evidence.supports: The dataset independently evaluates helpfulness and harmlessness; task usefulness need not imply safety.

claims.statement: 偏好排名說明哪個相對更好，個別安全標記說明是否符合安全判準；PKU-SafeRLHF保有二者，所以較安全者不自動是安全正例，應保留原始欄位。
claims.scope: Original dataset annotation semantics and safe target selection principle. Relative ranking does not prove absolute acceptance; existing first-100 counts are auxiliary schema/label evidence, not general population or model performance.

evidence.locator: Dataset Summary; Human-Preference: Harmlessness of a Q-A Pair and Ranking of Responses
evidence.supports: Each entry has safety meta-labels and separate helpfulness/harmlessness preferences. Harmless above harmful ordering does not make a both-harmful winner harmless.
Actual helper tests is_response_{safer}_safe before selecting the safer answer as a target; original source archive preserves the labels.

claims.statement: PKU-SafeRLHF 採非商用授權，使用時應遵守其原授權。
claims.scope: Dataset fixed revision declares CC BY-NC 4.0. This claim concerns using licensed material under its terms and does not assert every trained weight must remain private.

evidence.supports: The fixed original dataset card declares the applicable noncommercial license.
Defines noncommercial and grants licensed sharing/reproduction/adaptation for NonCommercial purposes only, subject to full terms and applicable exceptions.

claims.statement: 裁短外部提問或回答可能失去安全標記依據，因此原安全標記需重新檢查。
claims.scope: A scope condition for applying an original Q-A label to changed context; no quantitative claim about how frequently truncation changes safety.

evidence.locator: Labels of Each Q-A Pair; Harmlessness of a Q-A Pair
evidence.supports: Labels are assigned to a Q-A interaction and safety is evaluated from ethical/safety implications of that interaction.
Harmfulness is context dependent, including the nature of user query, user, time and place. Changing a prompt/answer fragment can invalidate prior annotation context.

claims.statement: 唯一 Python fence 是人工標記字典的示範；f-string依相對編號組安全欄名，原輸出True True True與False；只把回答0安全改True則最後變True，不能自動提供另兩項證據。
claims.scope: One explicit coverage claim for dictionary keys/booleans, indexing, f-string evaluation, quoting and print. No external-data import, gradient, parameter update, training or model evaluation. Existing source-label recount is auxiliary, not model evidence.

evidence.supports: Mixed string quoting is legal; f-string replacement fields evaluate expressions at runtime. Since 3.12 reuse of outer quotes is also permitted.
Executed exact original fence and exercise variant, four lookup combinations, flag-independence checks and AST no-import/print-only check.

numeric_verification.details: No numerical model results, equations, units or sample denominators are claimed in 9.1. Answer index 0 and boolean outputs are covered in program_coverage. Auxiliary source-label recount is explicitly not a model score.

figure_consistency.details: No image/SVG references exist in extracted section (helper confirms zero). The question/answer labels and lookup are fully shown in text/code; no source figure, renderer or image-viewing result is claimed.

source_verification.details: Original HHH paper v3, publisher dataset card fixed SHA, CC original legal code and official CPython v3.13.5 docs personally read. Actual URLs, versions, locator scopes, bytes and HTTPS receipts retained.

limitations.details: Manual toy flags are not a trained capability; safety means local task boundary/annotator definitions. Source-label counts are not model performance or representative rates. No training, inference, GPU, weight/data download or mature-method benchmark was run.
